description: Find property managers in Zillow's professional directory by city, ZIP or neighborhood, or read specific directory and profile URLs. No login, cookie or API key is required.

endPage.description: Maximum directory pages to crawl per location or directory URL. Each page contains 16 profiles and Zillow clamps at page 25.
endPage.title: Max directory pages

isTopAgent.description: Only include profiles Zillow has awarded its Top Professional badge.
isTopAgent.title: Top professionals only

languages.description: Only include profiles that speak at least one of these languages. Leave empty for all languages.
languages.title: Languages

locations.description: One location per line: city and state ("Dallas, TX"), ZIP code ("92104"), or a neighborhood ("Hyde Park, Austin, TX"). Each location is searched with the Property Management specialty filter.
locations.title: Locations

maxManagers.description: Maximum number of property manager profiles to return. Zillow serves at most 400 per location and filter combination (16 per page, 25 pages).
maxManagers.title: Max managers

maxReviews.description: Maximum recent reviews to include per profile. Zillow exposes the 10 most recent reviews on a profile page.
maxReviews.title: Max reviews per profile

mode.description: What to scrape. Search by location uses the directory; Scrape specific URLs reads directory pages and profile pages you supply.
enumTitles: Search by city, ZIP or neighborhood
mode.title: Mode

specialties.description: Zillow professional specialties to include. The actor is built for property managers, so Property Management is selected by default; add another specialty to widen the search.
specialties.title: Specialties

startUrls.description: Zillow professionals directory pages or individual profile URLs. Legacy /professionals/property-manager-reviews/... URLs are converted to the live directory path automatically.
startUrls.title: Zillow URLs

title: Zillow Property Manager Directory Input
